judge.rationale: The candidate implements the exact same design choice as the reference, renaming the parameter to `totalUsage` on `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` (plus a helpful JSDoc comment) and summing token fields across tool rounds while ignoring `undefined` rounds. All acceptance criteria from the ticket are completely satisfied, including the two-tool-round test (3 provider calls), partial/missing usage handling, spec update, and CHANGELOG entry. Minor differences from the reference include placing the `addUsage` helper in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, putting the new integration tests in a separate acceptance test file rather than `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and placing the new spec bullets under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of promoting it to the main section and updating `CLAUDE.md`/`specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
